_note: 21 hand-written fictional messages. 'alias_only' messages name their project only by an alternate name. 'stale_removed' lists the five projects dropped for the stale-taxonomy condition. 'sweep' is the 10-message subset for the verbalizer sweep; each is scored against the same fixed shortlist of those 10 messages' projects.

messages.subject: Spindle beta onboarding checklist
messages.body:
Following up on the Spindle private beta. We need the customer tenant allowlisted before Friday so their team can publish components to the registry. Can you confirm the onboarding checklist is final and that the Spindle docs link works for external users?

Thanks,
Priya

messages.subject: Hydra cutover rehearsal — Saturday
messages.body: Hydra rehearsal is booked for Saturday 06:00. We will freeze writes on the order database, promote the new primary, and measure replica lag before we flip traffic. If Hydra rehearsal goes cleanly we keep the production date. Please be on the bridge call.

messages.subject: Kestrel price book review
messages.body: Attached is the draft Kestrel price book with the three usage tiers. Finance wants the metered overage rate settled before the Kestrel pricing page goes live. Can we review the tier boundaries on Thursday?

messages.subject: Marlin A/B results
messages.body: The Marlin one-page checkout variant lifted conversion by 3.1% over two weeks, with cart abandonment down on mobile. I recommend we ship Marlin to 100% next sprint and retire the old checkout flow.

messages.subject: Quillbook chart of accounts mapping
messages.body: The Quillbook team finished mapping the chart of accounts. About forty legacy accounts have no target yet. Could you review the mapping sheet so we can load opening balances and test journal entries in Quillbook next week?

messages.subject: Bramble: IdP metadata from partners
messages.body: Three partners have sent their SAML metadata for Bramble. The fourth still uses a password login to the partner portal. Can we set a deadline, after which Bramble single sign-on becomes mandatory for all partners?

messages.subject: Cobalt: warehouse spend down 18%
messages.body: Update on Cobalt. After suspending the idle clusters and rewriting the two nightly jobs, warehouse spend is down 18% month on month. The next Cobalt step is moving cold tables to cheaper storage.

messages.subject: Fennel renewals due in Q4
messages.body: Here is the Fennel tracker. Eleven vendor contracts renew in Q4, and four of them have a 90-day termination notice window that closes this month. Please flag any you want to cancel so Fennel can send the notices.

messages.subject: Obsidian evidence requests
messages.body: The auditor has sent the second batch of Obsidian evidence requests for the SOC 2 Type II window. Most are access reviews and change tickets. Please upload your control evidence to the Obsidian folder by the 15th.

messages.subject: Garnet: card routing test plan
messages.body: For Garnet we plan to route 5% of card traffic to the new processor next Tuesday and compare authorisation rates. If Garnet authorisation rates hold, we step to 25% the following week.

messages.subject: Halyard 4.12 release candidate
messages.body: Halyard 4.12 release candidate is in TestFlight. Two crash fixes and the new settings screen. Halyard ships to the app store on Wednesday unless QA finds a blocker.

messages.subject: Fraudwatch false declines
messages.body: Since the new Fraudwatch model went live, false declines are up among first-time buyers in Brazil. Can the Fraudwatch team lower the risk score threshold for that segment while we retrain?

messages.subject: Juniper floor plan v3
messages.body: Attached is Juniper floor plan v3. Engineering gets the whole third floor, and the desks by the windows go to hot-desking. Movers are booked for the Juniper move on the 28th.

messages.subject: Wren: first 40 articles migrated
messages.body: Wren progress: forty support articles have been rewritten and migrated to the new knowledge base. Search inside Wren now covers billing and account topics; the remaining FAQ pages are next.

messages.subject: Tamarind buddy assignments
messages.body: Six new engineers start on Monday. Here are the Tamarind buddy assignments and the first-week schedule. Each buddy should book a Tamarind check-in on day three.

messages.subject: Kiln: remote cache results
messages.body: Kiln milestone: with the remote cache enabled and tests sharded eight ways, median CI build time fell from 19 to 7 minutes. Next for Kiln is caching the Docker layers.

messages.subject: Nimbus Licensing true-up
messages.body: Nimbus Licensing sent the annual true-up: we are 140 seats over the enterprise agreement. Before we accept, can IT confirm the real seat count from the Nimbus admin console?

messages.subject: Plover: per diem rates
messages.body: Plover draft is ready for review. The main changes are new per diem rates for London and Singapore, and travel booking has to go through the approved tool. Comments on Plover by Friday please.

messages.subject: Alder: node pool upgrade window
messages.body: Alder upgrade window: we roll the production node pools to the new Kubernetes version on Tuesday night, one zone at a time. Workloads without pod disruption budgets will be flagged in the Alder channel.

messages.subject: Egret erasure request backlog
messages.body: Egret now closes subject access requests automatically, but erasure requests still need manual checks in three systems. We have 23 GDPR erasure requests in the backlog. Can Egret cover the billing system next?

messages.subject: Thistle identity resolution rules
messages.body: For Thistle, the proposal is to merge customer profiles on verified email first and device id second. That removes about 9% duplicates from event tracking. Please review the Thistle identity resolution rules before we enable them.
